projects.title: Environmental Time Series Forecasting Capstone
bullets: Aligned public river-level sensor time series using Python and pandas for a supervised undergraduate capstone on environmental forecasting.
Implemented a seasonal baseline and plotted forecast residuals as assigned components of the capstone's forecasting analysis.

research.title: Static Checks for Programming Exercises
bullets: Parsed small public list-processing example programs and implemented abstract syntax tree traversal in Python as a supervised student research assistant.
Wrote checks for selected code patterns in the public example programs as part of supervised research on static checks for programming exercises.
